Article 71 of the UN Charter opened the door for suitable arrangements for consultation with NGOs. This relationship with ECOSOC is governed today by ECOSOC resolution 1996/31 (PDF). International, regional and national NGOs, non-profit public or voluntary organizations are eligible to obtain consultative status.
